status: source audit and planned measurements; not performance acceptance
representation: ArrayPlace carries layout, image address, concrete/dynamic memory, bounds, and origin.
ArrayView adds caller-allocated count/prefix captures; ElementPlace retains the stack address transport.
No new per-access heap object or new per-element vector is introduced. Existing ArrayWalk containers remain.
FrameArrayOwner keeps a constructor-scoped pointer to the stable caller Slot only to retain exact parent address emission. Its current uses do not escape the constructor call.
limits: Source inspection is not an allocation or compiler-speed measurement.
Larger value structs and repeated layout queries can increase host compiler work even with identical emitted modules.
The thin-known-nonzero fix adds bank-bit materialization only to a private form unused by current accepted lowering.
No full backend or Stage D completion is claimed.
